section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the validation of a Romanian translation of the Subjective Happiness Scale (SHS) using a sample of N=453 participants. A principal-axis exploratory factor analysis confirmed a single-factor structure with good psychometric properties (KMO=.77, 63.0% variance explained), and Cronbach's alpha values of .89 for women and .92 for men. The section does not contain information about body appreciation assessment, BMI, or other demographic characteristics relevant to the main extraction targets.
